title: Mixing: Goodnight Tonight, Daytime Nighttime Suffering by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

A mixing session for Wings’ ‘Goodnight Tonight’ single took place on 1 February 1979.

Paul McCartney oversaw mixes of the song and its b-side, ‘Daytime Nighttime Suffering’.

None of the day’s mixes were released, however. ‘Goodnight Tonight’ was mixed again on 5, 8, and 9 February, and 2 March 1979, and ‘Daytime Nighttime Suffering’ was mixed on 2 March.

Page last updated: 30 January 2026
